title: Boat driving licence and vessel registrations – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page explains that Service NSW is collecting information to verify your identity and link your MyServiceNSW Account to Transport for NSW for managing boat driving licences and vessel registrations.
intro:
Service NSW is collecting this information for the purpose of verifying your identity and enabling you to link your MyServiceNSW Account to Transport for NSW (the NSW Government agency that manages NSW Boat Driving Licences and vessel registrations).

This will allow you to access:

To link your account with Transport for NSW, we will verify your identity document details against your Transport for NSW customer information.

This statement is in addition to the MyServiceNSW Account Terms and Conditions and Privacy collection notice.

Service NSW will not disclose your personal information to anyone else unless you provide your consent, or we are required or authorised to do so by law.

For further information on how Service NSW handles your privacy, go to our Privacy statement.

external_links.text: log in on the Service NSW website

faqs.q: Why is Service NSW collecting my information?
faqs.a: Service NSW is collecting this information to verify your identity and enable you to link your MyServiceNSW Account to Transport for NSW.

faqs.q: What information can I access by linking my account?
faqs.a: Linking your account allows you to access services related to NSW Boat Driving Licences and vessel registrations.

faqs.q: Who can Service NSW share my personal information with?
faqs.a: Service NSW will not disclose your personal information unless you give your consent, or if they are required or authorized to do so by law.
